sections.heading: 회귀·보안 신호
sections.body:
**Claude Code is steganographically marking requests**

When ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a non-official API host, Claude Code encodes proxy/reseller classification into the system-prompt date line using Unicode apos

영향: Teams routing Claude Code through internal gateways or third-party proxies may unknowingly send hidden client-classification signals on every turn, undermining 

> Claude Code can silently change two things: The apostrophe in Today's and the date separator, from - to /. This is prompt steganography, a technique used to hide data in plain sight.

[원문 확인](https://thereallo.dev/blog/claude-code-prompt-steganography)

**Claude Code sends your email address to websites**

Signed-in Claude Code placed the user’s account email in outbound User-Agent headers on web and curl-style requests; Anthropic added default cc-plugin-privacy g

영향: Agentic web browsing can leak paying customers’ identities to arbitrary sites, enabling harassment and phishing without a clear in-product audit trail.

> I receive dozens of scam emails per day because claude code divulged my email to arbitrary 3rd parties in the User-Agent request header while conducting web searches without my permission.

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/107757)

**The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode**

After npm v2.1.88 briefly shipped a 60MB cli.js.map, reversers documented anti-distillation fake-tool injection, undercover mode that hides AI authorship in OSS

영향: Procurement and security reviews must account for undisclosed enforcement mechanisms (attestation, decoy tools, covert modes) that shape interoperability with t

> Earlier today, a Claude Code release included some internal source code. No sensitive customer data or credentials were involved or exposed. This was a release packaging issue caused by human error

[원문 확인](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/artificial-intelligence/claude-code-source-code-accidentally-leaked-in-npm-package/)

**Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates**

Users reported sharp quality drops in long, multi-step coding sessions starting in February–March 2026; Anthropic later traced overlapping client-side changes (

영향: Complex-repo workflows need observable harness behavior (effort defaults, thinking retention, prompts) because client changes can mimic model degeneration and b

> The model went from 6.6 reads per edit to 2.0 reads per edit — a 70% reduction in research before making changes.

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/42796)

**Codex CLI installs a persistent, self-updating background daemon by default**

From Codex CLI 0.157.0, interactive sessions default to daemon_auto_start, spawning a persistent app-server, copying ~374MB into ~/.codex, and running an hourly

영향: Coding agents become undeclared infrastructure: background processes, duplicate binaries, and environment pinning conflict with corporate endpoint policy and re

> Since 0.157.0, just opening an interactive codex session: Starts a persistent background daemon... Copies the whole platform package (~374 MB)... Starts a detached updater

[원문 확인](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/48195)

**v2.1.328**

Claude Code 2.1.328(2026-11-19)은 MCP hook 실패 시 block, 셀프호스티드 러너 메트릭·CLI 플래그 확장, Code Mode·원격 세션 대량 수정, 서드파티 게이트웨이용 auto mode를 포함합니다.

영향: 엔터프라이즈·셀프호스티드·Code Mode 사용자는 hook 실패 처리와 오케스트레이터 observability 변경이 권한·안정성 회귀에 직접 영향을 줍니다.

> Added "onFailure": "block" for mcp_tool hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328)

**Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from**

Enterprise admins on GitHub Enterprise Cloud can require Copilot customizations (skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, extensions) to come only from plugins or ma

영향: This is a governance control for agent supply chains: you can allow MCP and canvas capabilities while blocking ad-hoc user/project configs that bypass marketpla

> The strictPluginOnlyCustomization managed setting blocks standalone customizations from user and project sources.

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-16-control-where-github-copilot-customizations-come-from/)

**Bulk start AI Scan for repositories**

GitHub가 조직·리포지토리 단위에서 AI Scan을 최대 20개 저장소까지 한 번에 시작할 수 있는 벌크 기능을 퍼블릭 프리뷰로 공개했습니다.

영향: 코딩 에이전트와 별개로 저장소 기본 브랜치의 취약점을 AI로 스캔·백로그에 적재할 수 있어, 에이전트가 대량 수정·커밋하는 팀의 보안 게이트 설계와 함께 봐야 합니다. Copilot 라이선스는 필요 없습니다.

> You can now start AI Scans for up to 20 repositories at once. Bulk start for AI Scan for repositories is in public preview. A GitHub Copilot license isn’t required.

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-16-bulk-start-ai-scan-for-repositories)
